## Statements

- Stated by vendor (longcat-faq, Error Handling, Q: What does "context_length_exceeded" mean?): A context_length_exceeded error means the input plus max_tokens is over the window. Lower max_tokens or trim messages before retrying.
- Stated by vendor (longcat-faq, Performance, Q: Is there a rate limit?): The API limits requests per key and answers 429 when exceeded. Retry with exponential backoff instead of tight loops.
- Stated by vendor (longcat-faq, API Keys, Q: Can I use the same API Key for both OpenAI and Anthropic endpoints?): One platform key works for every LongCat model and for both the OpenAI-style and Anthropic-style endpoints.
- Stated by vendor (longcat-change-log, 2026-09-25 LongCat-2.5-Preview Now Available): LongCat-2.5-Preview accepts image input as well as text; LongCat-2.0 stays text only. It is a preview, and OpenCode Go serves it under the -free id.

## Disagreements

- `longcat-2.0` contextWindow: longcat-quick-start states `1000000`; kept `262144`. The released config sets 262,144 positions; the vendor quick start advertises a 1M window for its own API. The artifact value is kept; the vendor API may accept more.
